title: Shark holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shark body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='58' rx='30' ry='16' fill='#3A6FA8'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='66' rx='24' ry='8' fill='#9DD3F0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <polygon points='14,58 4,44 10,58 4,72' fill='#2E5A8A'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <polygon points='48,42 56,26 64,42' fill='#2E5A8A'/>
  <!-- pectoral fin -->
  <polygon points='40,70 30,82 52,72' fill='#2E5A8A'/>
  <!-- snout shading -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='56' rx='9' ry='10' fill='#4F86BE'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M60 62 Q68 70 76 60' stroke='#C9E9F8' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <polygon points='62,63 64,68 66,63' fill='#F4FBFF'/>
  <polygon points='70,64 72,69 74,63' fill='#F4FBFF'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#F4FBFF'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#1E3C5C'/>
  <!-- gills -->
  <path d='M46 52 Q44 58 46 64' stroke='#2E5A8A' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M51 52 Q49 58 51 64' stroke='#2E5A8A' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- heart held by fin -->
  <path d='M70 84 C64 78 58 82 62 88 C64 91 70 94 72 92 C74 94 80 91 82 88 C86 82 80 78 74 84 Z' fill='#F0456B'/>
  <path d='M70 84 C67 80.5 62 82 63.5 86' stroke='#FF8FA8' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- little fin arm holding heart -->
  <path d='M56 74 Q62 80 66 82' stroke='#3A6FA8' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
